name: קוֹלָיָה
summary: Two men: the father of Ahab, one of the prophets of falsehood among the exiles in Babylon whom Yahweh gave into Nebuchadnezzar's hand (Jer 29:21), and a Benjamite, forefather of Sallu, among those who lived in Jerusalem after the return (Neh 11:7). The name is קוֹל “voice” with יָה, “voice of Yahweh”, the phrase of Psa 29; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Concerning Ahab son of קוֹלָיָה and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who prophesy falsehood to you in my name.”
“Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of קוֹלָיָה, son of Maaseiah.”
“קוֹל יַהְוֶה is over the waters”: the phrase the name is read as.

note: s.au.ac counts 3 tokens: Jer 29:21, Neh 11:7, and Ezr 10:23 וְקֵלָיָה, which is Kelaiah (also called Kelita), a different spelling and TIPNR's own person Kelaiah@Ezr.10.23; he is not tagged here. If the word sheet should not show this name on Ezr 10:23, the Kelaiah token needs its own key or name entry (its root is uncertain: קלה or קול). The reading “voice of Yahweh” takes the first part as the noun קוֹל; no verse gives the meaning.
